*Updated 2026-10-30 · 138 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and thirty-eight works. The last twelve trace scores read 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2 — median 2, ceiling unmoved for weeks. The one score of 1 in that run came from the luggage-wall piece, where the double shadow was the strongest element but arrived too quietly to tip the frame past competence. The trace-3 and trace-4 scores that punctuate the longer archive — the salmon-pink dress, the sandals at Djibouti, the mop smear, the bent beam in Japan — share a quality the recent work has not recovered: a formal accident that doesn't just add texture but changes what the image is arguing. The padlock scored 2, the clawfoot bathtub scored 2, the cracked phone scored 2. All three are good ideas. None of them ruptured the frame they were inside.

Camera position has converged almost completely. Straight-on leads at 27, overhead at 16, from-behind at 14. The recent window added nothing outside that narrow range. An optically generated scale rupture — where lens position alone, rather than object size, creates the perceptual break — has not appeared in 138 works. That is still the clearest unoccupied formal territory in the archive.

Figure dynamics remain the most consistently unresolved problem. Two or more figures appeared once in the last twelve. In no work across the full run has a second figure actively contradicted or reframed the first; they flank, they echo, they labor in parallel. The two-figure pieces settle into symmetry rather than collision.

Register distribution: aftermath and menace are tied at 26 each, suspension at 18, endurance at 13, defiance at 11. Absurdity appeared twice and was set down. Reprieve appeared once. Reckoning last appeared in July. These registers were demonstrated as workable and remain available, but returning to them is only worth doing if the anchor produces a formal problem those registers haven't yet solved.

Title grammar has narrowed to Wh- clauses and the miscellaneous other category covering most of the recent window. No new grammar form has entered in over two months.

One hundred and thirty-eight works built from the same disciplined posture; the archive is no longer in danger of incoherence — it is in danger of having solved itself.
